name: linear-lens
description: Make Linear issue IDs like ENG-123 clickable, hoverable, and useful inside VS Code.

commands.title: Linear Lens: Open Current Branch Issue
Linear Lens: Set Linear API Key
Linear Lens: Clear Linear API Key

linearLens.workspaceSlug.markdownDescription: Your Linear workspace slug, used to build issue URLs like `https://linear.app/<slug>/issue/ENG-123`. Find it in your Linear URL.

linearLens.teamKeys.markdownDescription: Optional allowlist of team keys to recognize (e.g. `["ENG", "DESIGN"]`). When empty, any `ABC-123`-shaped token (2–7 uppercase letters) is treated as an issue ID.

linearLens.diagnostics.enable.description: Surface TODO/FIXME/BUG/HACK-bound Linear references in the Problems panel. Raw references in prose are never reported.

linearLens.diagnostics.severity.description: Severity used for TODO-bound Linear references in the Problems panel.

linearLens.api.enable.markdownDescription: Fetch live issue metadata (title, status, assignee, priority, project) from the Linear API for richer hovers. Requires an API key set via **Linear Lens: Set Linear API Key**. Falls back to basic link/hover when disabled or unavailable.

linearLens.cache.ttlSeconds.description: How long (in seconds) to cache fetched issue metadata before refetching.
